o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یل (yıl), from Proto-Turkic *yïl (“year”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰘𐰃𐰞 (yïl).
Borrowed from Russian пе́нис (pénis), from Latin pēnis (“tail, penis”).
Internationalism; from Russian янва́рь (janvárʹ), from Latin Iānuārius.
From Ottoman Turkish فرطونه (fırtuna, fırtına), from Greek φουρτούνα (fourtoúna).
